answer: An attacker running 117 aliases thus needs 47 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in kernel, expire in yarrow, and bridge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1478 identities would post 977 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
